title: Faceless Youtube Project
description:
Test Edit — Blockbuster Opening (~50 sec, Paid Trial $15)

Short paid trial before ongoing work on a faceless business-documentary channel (rise-and-fall-of-companies storytelling). I want to see your editing, pacing, and sound design on the most important stretch of a video: the opening 50 seconds.

What I’m providing:

The voiceover track (attached, ~50 sec) — the opening of a Blockbuster downfall video
A full line-by-line edit blueprint (attached doc) with the exact VO, the four beats, and notes on cuts, b-roll, graphics, and sound for each moment

What to deliver:

A finished edit of this ~50-second opening, cut to the provided voiceover
Footage/b-roll on every line, the stat graphics (template-based stat cards are fine), sound design, and a color grade
Export-ready: 1080p, 16:9, H.264 MP4

Read the blueprint — but here’s what I’m judging, in order:

The first 10 seconds. The hook is a Blockbuster card dropping in silence — no music, no intro, no logo. If you slap music over it or add an intro, that’s an automatic fail.
Pacing. A visual on every line, cuts riding the voiceover, no dead frames.
The contrast cut from giant Blockbuster to tiny Netflix — does the edit make me feel the size gap?
Sound design — music ducked under the VO, and the scripted silences preserved.
Footage sourcing — licensed and clean, not random low-res clips. (Use licensed/editorial footage or silhouettes — no unlicensed photos of the real founders or execs.)

Why this matters: This 50-second cut tells me almost everything about whether you can handle the full 11–13 min video. If the opening lands, the ongoing role is yours.

Please confirm your turnaround for this test and send any questions after reading the blueprint.

title: Editor for founder talking-head TikToks and Reels (ongoing, UK business)
description:
Hi, I’m Anna, founder of My Name Changed, the UK’s first done-for-you name change service. TikTok is where nearly all our customers come from, and it’s all me talking to camera on my phone. I need an editor who can make those videos pop without making them look like an ad.

*How it works*
I film on content days and do the rough cut myself in CapCut. Sometimes you’ll get a batch, sometimes just one video. I need the first one back within 48 hours, then one every 24 hours after that until the batch is done.

To start, the job is finishing only: don’t cut, trim or reorder anything, and don’t add hook text. If it goes well, I’d like to hand over the full edit from raw footage too (cutting fillers, pulling the best line to the front as the hook), so tell me if that’s something you do.

*What finishing means*
Captions 2 to 3 words at a time, just below my face and clear of the TikTok buttons, with key words highlighted in Copper. Swears censored in the captions only. No emoji
Punch-in zooms (100 to 110%) on key lines, with a quiet pop on the highlighted words
Animated stickers only at the moments I list. Playful, never cheesy, no wedding clichés
Happy for gifs where it makes sense
Blur any paperwork that’s visible and check it by eye, not just the AI blur
9:16

*The look*
Warm, handmade and a bit cheeky. Think hand-drawn arrows, highlighter strokes, scribbled notes, a “SORTED” stamp, little paperwork icons. Never flat, slick or templated.

*Colours*
Copper #C4573A (highlights and accents), 
Petrol #2F4B4A (dark), 
Parchment #F7F4EF (light)

*Fonts*
DM Sans for captions, 
Fraunces for any headings, 
Caveat for handwritten bits

*Please don’t*
Use stock photos or video, B-roll or transitions
Cut away from me. I’m the person people buy from, so I stay on screen
Add music. I add it in the app myself for licensing reasons

*You’ll be a good fit if*
You’ve done talking-head or founder content and can show me some
You can keep to a brief and a house style video after video, not just make one great edit
You’re fine with detailed feedback on the first few while we get a template locked in
You’ll tell me if something isn’t working

*Pay*
My budget is around $10 an hour, but I’d rather pay a fixed price per video. Please quote your rate for a finished video of up to 90 seconds, how long one usually takes you, and separately what you’d charge for a full edit from raw.

title: n8n automation: Google Drive to Claude captions to GoHighLevel Social Planner
description:
Title: n8n automation: Google Drive to Claude captions to GoHighLevel Social Planner

I run a wellness and fitness brand and need an experienced n8n builder to set up one workflow on n8n Cloud. Fixed price preferred. I want to be able to maintain and troubleshoot this myself after it's built, so teaching is a big part of this job.

What the workflow needs to do:

1. Watch several Google Drive folders. Each folder is an "asset bucket" for a type of social media content (for example, dancer foot pain or active adult balance).
2. When a new video or image is added, create a row in a Google Sheet with basic info based on which folder it came from.
3. Send the file name and that bucket's caption instructions to Claude (Anthropic API) to write a social caption and a first comment, then add both to the row. Each bucket will have its own instructions, hook style, and comment keyword.
4. Upload the file to the GoHighLevel media library through the GHL API (using a Private Integration token) and write the GHL media link back into the sheet. Google Drive links do not work for this, so the GHL link is required.
5. The finished sheet needs to match the format of GoHighLevel Social Planner's advanced bulk upload, so I can upload posts in bulk.

I currently have a Google Workspace Studio flow that handles part of step 2. You can replace it if keeping everything in n8n is cleaner.

Build requirements:
- Proven experience with n8n and the GoHighLevel API, especially media uploads
- Experience connecting n8n to the Anthropic (Claude) API
- Build and test on a copy of my sheet before touching the real one
- Clear error notifications sent to me by email or text, written in plain language, saying which step failed and which file it was

Training and handoff (required):
- A live screen share session (about 1 hour) where you teach me how to read n8n's execution log, find which step failed, and fix the common problems
- A written troubleshooting guide covering the most likely breaks, such as an expired Google connection, an expired or changed GHL token, an empty Anthropic API balance, a file that's too large or the wrong format, and a renamed sheet column
- A recorded walkthrough showing how to edit caption instructions and add a new bucket
- 30 days of support after handoff for questions or fixes

To apply, please include:
- Your fixed price and timeline
- A similar automation you've built, especially anything involving GoHighLevel

Functional web application with the features listed above.

Responsive UI for desktop and mobile.

Complete source code in a Git repository.

Setup instructions and environment variable documentation.

Basic testing of the main generation workflow.

Budget: $120 fixed-price.

This is an MVP, not a complete social media management platform. Social account integrations, automatic publishing, team collaboration, subscriptions, and payment processing are not required.

Please share relevant AI application experience, your proposed implementation, and an estimated timeline. Mention any third-party API costs separately.

title: Brazilian Portuguese copy reviewer for ads, captions and a landing page (per batch, 24-hour turnaround)
description:
ABOUT US
Talk4Impact (Talk 4 Impact LLC, a US company) runs live online English speaking classes for professionals who understand English but freeze when they speak at work. The plan is $49 a month for 8 live small-group classes, with a 7-day free trial. Our new website launches on 30 November, and our ads in Brazil start in December.

WHAT WE NEED
A native Brazilian Portuguese reviewer with marketing copy experience. You make sure every line we publish in Portuguese sounds natural to a Brazilian professional, is correct, and keeps its meaning. Nothing in Portuguese goes public without your OK.

WHAT YOU REVIEW
- Ad opening lines (hooks) and short ad texts.
- Captions and .srt subtitle files for short videos (timing stays; you fix the words).
- One landing page and its FAQ, then small updates.
- Now and then, a short email or message.

HOW YOU REVIEW
- Brazilian forms, "você", a plain, friendly register. No European Portuguese.
- Fix grammar, spelling and anything that sounds translated.
- Flag any line that could read as an exaggerated promise, and suggest a natural alternative.
- Keep the meaning: if a line can't be said naturally without changing it, tell us instead of rewriting the idea.
- Return a marked-up file (tracked changes or a two-column sheet: original, your version, a short note).
- We give you a short style sheet and our list of approved claims. You help keep the style sheet up to date.

DEFINITION OF DONE (each batch)
- Every line in the batch reviewed, with your version and a short note wherever you changed something.
- Returned within 24 hours of sending, in the agreed format.
- No line changes the meaning or adds a promise that isn't in our approved claims list.

VOLUME AND TIMING
- Batches, usually 1-3 a week. Expected size: a few hundred to about 2,000 words per batch (more in launch weeks).
- Turnaround: 24 hours from when we send a batch.
- Start: the first week of November.

PRICING
Per batch, fixed price. In your proposal, please quote your price per 1,000 words and your minimum per batch (for small batches like 10 hooks).

PAID TEST
Review 10 ad hooks (about 100-150 words) with notes, within 24 hours, for $10 fixed price on Upwork. If it goes well, we continue with per-batch milestones.

title: Native Saudi Speaker To Proof Read Captions
description:
We’re a social media agency serving salons, spas, wellness studios and clinics in Saudi Arabia and the UAE. We write Instagram content in everyday Saudi Arabic: post covers, carousel slides, Reel captions, ads and customer reply scripts.

We need a native Saudi proofreader to make sure every line sounds natural to a Riyadh audience, as if a local brand wrote it. The goal isn’t formal Arabic. It’s the casual, warm Saudi dialect brands use on Instagram.

What you’ll do:

Review Arabic drafts and correct anything that doesn’t sound natural in Saudi: words from other dialects (Emirati, Kuwaiti, Levantine, Egyptian), stiff or translated phrasing, spelling and grammar.
Suggest better wording where a line is correct but weak.
Give a short reason for each change (for example “sounds Emirati” or “sounds translated”). We use your notes to update our style guide, so your feedback directly shapes future content.
Answer occasional quick questions such as “Is X or Y more natural?”
Flag anything that could read as inappropriate or culturally off for a Saudi audience.

Volume and timing:

Batches of about 30–60 short pieces, roughly 2–4 times a month.
Turnaround within 24–48 hours.
Changes go into a shared document or spreadsheet.

To apply, please answer:

Which city are you from, and which dialect do you speak day to day?
Which sounds more natural for a Riyadh salon’s Instagram, «تبون» or «تبغون»? Why?
Share an example of Arabic marketing or social media copy you wrote or edited, if you have one.
What’s your rate per batch (about 40 short lines) or per hour?
